message: 起動せよ！　ジャイアントシン！
Hmm...
Azel didn't show up to class again today...
Well, not just class, homeroom too.
It bothers me... It really bothers me...
If she were rebelling against something, maybe it'd be simple, but that doesn't seem to be the case.
Aaah, I really want to do something about this... I want her to have a sparkling, heart-pounding school life too. Even if I'm being nosy.
Still, what am I supposed to do? I can't skip during class, and after school I have Student Council activities so I don't have the time for it...
As the Student Council president, I can't skip class or neglect Student Council activities just for one person...

Helena-san told me to look out for her, so I do think I need to keep an eye on her, but... I can't skip during class, and after school I have Student Council activities so I don't have the time for it...
As the Student Council president, I can't skip class or neglect Student Council activities just for one person...

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon Lord. If you gotta use the bathroom, it ain't this way.」

name: Synn
message: 「I might've been groaning, but it's not the bathroom.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Adolescent troubles, huh? Then go ahead and talk to the Great Sage Paqy-sama.」
Calling himself 'Great Sage' actually makes him less trustworthy... Well, whatever.

name: Synn
message: 「It's about Azel.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What, nothing to do with adolescence? So, what's up with the mysterious transfer student?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel doesn't come to class, and it doesn't look like she's making any friends either, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that's just her reaping what she sows.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so, but I can't just leave things like this.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think it's fine to just leave her alone.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't do that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look, the fact that the school authorities aren't making a fuss means they don't care whether she shows up to class or not.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, Helena-san told me to look out for her...」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Student Council's swamped right now, so there's no way you can spare anyone for a transfer student.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I say you just look out for her once Kirafes is over.」
It's just a hunch, but I feel like that'll be too late...

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I was thinking of asking Sally-chan to snoop around and find out what Azel's doing when she skips class.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...I don't think she'll take you up on that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You might not have noticed, Demon Lord, but that flat-chested Sally is avoiding the mysterious transfer student. No doubt about it.」
Now that he mentions it, maybe she is... Even though she's so friendly, I've never seen her messing around with Azel.

name: Helena
message: 「'Good morning, Mr. Student Council President.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Good morning.」

name: Helena
message: 「'The reason I have summoned you is none other than this.'」
We just ran into each other in the hallway, though.

name: Helena
message: 「'I want you to track down Azel, the exchange student from the Principality of Sharo-Ma.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I have Student Council work--」

name: Helena
message: 「'I wish you all the best of luck. As always, this tape will self-destruct in thirty seconds.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it about time you dropped the whole 'tape' medium thing?」

name: Helena
message: 「It has to be a tape, or it's no good.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's 'cause she's old.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, my. Compared to you, I'm waaaay younger.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, what's that supposed to...」

name: Helena
message: 「Kaboom!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What was that all of a sudden?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Because thirty seconds passed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I see. Still, why me?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's not just because you happened to be here. You and Azel-chan are kinda close, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Me and Azel?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right. In horse-racing terms, you're leading by half a length.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just your imagination. Azel doesn't pay any attention to me at all.」

name: Helena
message: 「Acting cold just means she's conscious of you.」

name: Synn
message: 「What year is that rom-com trope from?」

name: Helena
message: 「The classic tropes are always beautiful, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, it *has* to be you, Synn-chan. I have solid proof to back this up.」

name: Synn
message: 「And what would that be?」

name: Helena
message: 「Woman's intuition.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. Zero proof whatsoever.」

name: Helena
message: 「'Synn Sakura. Your assignment to this case is already decided.'」

name: Synn
message: 「'Understood, Boss. Though unworthy, I, Synn Sakura, shall devote body and soul to this mission.'」

name: Helena
message: 「'Mm. I expect great things. Furthermore, should the mission fail, the authorities will disavow any knowledge of your whereabouts, so keep that in mind.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, don't just carry on the conversation by yourself!」

name: Helena
message: 「You're no fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I'm not worried about Azel, either. Still, like I said earlier, having the Student Council President skip out on duties is...」

name: Helena
message: 「It'll be fine.」

name: Helena
message: 「HEY, come on!」
When Helena-san snapped her fingers.

name: Sally
message: 「What is it, BOSS?」

name: Helena
message: 「Mm. Making your entrance just as I taught you--I'm satisfied.」

name: Sally
message: 「Because Prez was dragging his heels, I couldn't come out of the air vent for ages! It's cramped in there, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's my fault?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, bring out the goods.」

name: Sally
message: 「Aye-aye, Great Oyabin... I mean, BOSS!」

name: Sally
message: 「'Copy-Paste Robo-kun'」

name: Synn
message: 「What is this?」
It looks like nothing more than a tiny mannequin to me, though.

name: Sally
message: 「With this treasure I got from Demon World Mail-Order, you can sabotage and escape to your heart's content!」

name: Sally
message: 「This clever Copy-Paste Robo-kun will do everything in your place」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, it doesn't look like me at all, though」

name: Sally
message: 「If you press this button on the nose, lo and behold, it becomes a spitting image of whoever pressed it」
If I'm going to end up forced into doing it anyway.

name: Synn
message: 「...Alright, boop」
It certainly stopped being a mannequin, though.

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. It looks just like Prez!」

name: Synn
message: 「How!? It's got seams under its eyes! Its rivets are showing! And there's something like a propeller stuck on its head!」

name: Helena
message: 「It's the spitting image of you. This will work just fine」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Helena
message: 「That cheesy-cool look like a robot from an old anime has quite the charm. Truly retro-futuristic」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't that mean it doesn't look like me after all!?」

name: Sally
message: 「All that's left is to wind up the mainspring with this key, and it's good to go」

name: Synn
message: 「A mainspring...」

name: Helena
message: 「A mainspring--how very eco-friendly」

name: Sally
message: 「If you wind the key on its head nice and tight, it'll wake right up」

name: Synn
message: 「That wasn't a propeller, it was a wind-up key!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, go ahead and give it a good wind」

name: Helena
message: 「Now, activate, Giant Synn! Show us your power at this very moment!」
Giant Synn?

name: Copy
message: 「Mgh!」

name: Helena
message: 「Flawless」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm surprised it looks this much like you」

name: Synn
message: 「In what world!」

name: Copy
message: 「Mgh!」

name: Helena
message: 「It's fine. I've already taken precautions. Everyone on the Student Council might get suspicious, but they won't find out」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with that subtle phrasing?!」

name: Copy
message: 「Mgh!」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, go carry out your mission without a worry」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm terribly worried, though」

name: Helena
message: 「If you keep whining any more, there's no telling what Helena might do! I can't even imagine what'll happen to little Synn! Mmm, it gets me so excited」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn. I think you'd better give up. You're up against the wrong opponent」

name: Synn
message: 「...I don't think we'll find Azel by searching blindly, though」

name: Helena
message: 「According to the latest intel, little Azel should be near Finis Tower」

name: Synn
message: 「Where is that intel from?」

name: Helena
message: 「Naturally, it's woman's intuition」
Azel, Azel...

name: Synn
message: 「He's not here」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't rely on stuff like woman's intuition」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, maybe he moved by the time we got here」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure are positive, Lord Demon King」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, why are we heading this way?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I saw Azel at the church before」

name: Paqy
message: 「There he is」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like he really is heading toward the church」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't get what's so interesting about a place like that」

name: Synn
message: 「A Great Sage seems like he'd have ties to that kind of place, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Precisely because he's a Great Sage. Let me stake my life on saying this: God doesn't care one bit about the likes of us」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't know that for sure」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, yeah. That's something only God knows, after all」
An empty church. Azel was sitting in the front row.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel. What a coincidence」

name: Azel
message: 「...You again」

name: Synn
message: 「Mind if I sit next to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you come here, Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't there nobody else around here?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Because it's quiet」

name: Synn
message: 「It sure is quiet, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「And I get that sometimes you just want to be alone in a quiet place」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, I don't think you should go as far as skipping class to do it」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, wanting to be alone is something that suddenly hits you while you're interacting with all sorts of people」

name: Synn
message: 「I think that's different from being alone right from the start」

name: Synn
message: 「You're always by yourself, aren't you, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's gotten noisy」
Azel stood up without a sound.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you... hate people, Azel?」
Footsteps receding in silence.

name: Synn
message: 「Then why do you even attend this academy?」
Azel doesn't go to class. He barely even shows his face at homeroom. Yet, he always comes to the academy.

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」
There was no answer, and the footsteps left the church.
Where is he?

name: Paqy
message: 「I think it's about time you gave up, man」
Maybe so. Even still.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, I still haven't shown you how to use the library yet, have I」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, it's always quiet in the library.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Shut up.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. Nobody can make a racket in the library anyway. There's someone scary here, after all.」
Inside the dead-silent library, only Miss Melilot's voice echoes.

name: Melilot
message: 「That concludes the checkout procedure. Have you committed it to memory?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Or shall I explain it again from the very beginning?」
Silent pressure radiates from Miss Melilot.

name: Synn
message: 「You'd better answer her.」
When I warned him, he seemed to press his lips shut even tighter.

name: Melilot
message: 「Then I shall explain it again from the very beginning.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will explain from the beginning. First--」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not gonna use it, so never mind.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Whether you use it or not is irrelevant. Have you committed it to memory?」
A slender arm smoothly extended, and a hand was placed on Azel's shoulder.

name: Azel
message: 「W-What are you...」
Azel tried to shake it off, but wherever those slender fingers hid such strength, it looked like he couldn't escape.
Actually, I know from personal experience, too, that that grip leaves finger marks.

name: Melilot
message: 「Have you committed it to memory?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I-I got it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You are telling a lie, aren't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then I shall explain it from the very beginning. First, you write the title of the book you are borrowing on this library card.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I remember.」
When Azel answered looking utterly exasperated, Miss Melilot didn't even smile.

name: Melilot
message: 「This card is for writing down the title of the book you are borrowing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then I shall explain it from the very beginning. First, on this library card, you write the title of the book you wish to borrow.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You have understood up to this point, yes?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then, let me explain from the beginning. First--」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I get it!」

name: Azel
message: 「When borrowing a book, first, you write the title of the book you want to borrow on the library card.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am delighted that you have understood that much. Now, let us continue... Before that.」
Melilot-san's eyes locked onto me.

name: Melilot
message: 「Synn Sakura-kun. Are you not the Student Council President?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, yes, I am, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is very little time left until the Charity Bazaar. The Student Council ought to be busy. Why, then, are you here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well, that's...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was just in need of an extra pair of hands. You will help me, won't you?」
While keeping her right hand gripped on Azel's shoulder, her left index finger pointed.

name: Melilot
message: 「On that book cart, there are books that need to be returned to the shelves. You will put them back according to their classification, won't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... at a glance, it looks like there are over a hundred books here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please rest assured. There are ninety-eight.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you very much. Now then, Azel-san. I would like to resume the lecture on how to borrow books. Is that alright?」

name: Azel
message: 「You don't have to.」
Melilot-san's eyes were like a snake glaring at a frog.

name: Melilot
message: 「Is it alright if I resume?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I-It is alright.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Incidentally, at times like this, I believe answering with 'Yes' is more appropriate. Now then, allow me to resume.」
Azel looked around as if seeking salvation.
Our eyes met for just a second, though he immediately looked away.
Let's see... This book is politics and economics, and with this number... here, I guess.

name: Paqy
message: 「That woman, Melilot. She's no ordinary person.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true. After all, she's overwhelming even Azel」

name: Paqy
message: 「No, I'm sure it's not what you're thinking, Demon Lord……」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, it's nothing. Whoops, that book goes over here」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, you're right」

name: Synn
message: 「Heave-ho……」
Now then, for the next book…….

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless effort」
The quiet voice might be because the fear of Melilot has really sunk in.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. You're done with the explanation. Good work」
Azel glanced at my face, then immediately looked away.

name: Azel
message: 「The problem is there are too many books」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」
I replied without stopping my hands from working.

name: Azel
message: 「They're full of unnecessary things」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so…… I don't read all that much myself, but I think it's nice having plenty of them」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because the more there are, the higher the chance there's a book that suits me」

name: Azel
message: 「If it's high-precision information, a report is enough. If it's fantasy, it's unnecessary」

name: Synn
message: 「So you're saying they're useless?」

name: Azel
message: 「Correct」

name: Synn
message: 「Then we wouldn't need a library either」

name: Azel
message: 「One book is enough」

name: Synn
message: 「That way you wouldn't have to remember the borrowing procedures, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh……」
Melilot's lecture must have really gotten to him.

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean the others are pointless?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's what I'm saying. Your current efforts are pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of book is this one book you're talking about?」

name: Azel
message: 「A book in which the words of God are written」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's the only truth, and that's why it's necessary?」

name: Azel
message: 「Correct」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if such a book exists, though. How can you tell those are the words of God? Maybe someone just made it up」
While I was returning several books to the shelves, Azel remained silent, however.

name: Azel
message: 「That is... because it is a book passed down from the distant past」

name: Synn
message: 「Just because of that doesn't mean the book is necessarily the truth」

name: Azel
message: 「...Do you doubt God」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just saying we don't know if those are really God's words」

name: Azel
message: 「That is not true!」
A sudden loud voice.
I pressed a finger to my lips,

name: Synn
message: 「Shh. Be quiet」

name: Synn
message: 「Why can you say that's not the case?」
Taking a single deep breath, Azel spoke again in a quiet voice,

name: Azel
message: 「...Because my \{brethren|はらから} would never commit such a blasphemous act as fabricating the words of God」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So there's a book like that in your homeland, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Everyone has a copy of their own」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, isn't it possible that the person who heard God's words and wrote them down in a book didn't properly understand what they meant」

name: Azel
message: 「They are the words of God. They must have been conveyed in a way that anyone could understand without mistake」

name: Synn
message: 「Because they're God's words?」

name: Azel
message: 「Correct」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, even God might tell lies. He might speak in riddles, too. Or even pose puzzles」

name: Azel
message: 「Why would God do such a thing!?」
Another loud voice.
I pressed a finger to my lips,

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, keep it down」

name: Azel
message: 「B-Because you keep saying... weird things...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why, you ask... hmm」

name: Synn
message: 「Since we're talking about a god, there's no way someone like me could understand」

name: Azel
message: 「...If you don't understand. Don't say it」
Come to think of it, Uncle Amakawa used to say it's better not to bring up religion or politics.
Still, even if the conversation was a bit strange, maybe it was good that I got to talk this much with Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you might not be happy about it, Azel, but this country has tons of books」

name: Synn
message: 「Even from your perspective, Azel, I think the library is pretty great」

name: Synn
message: 「Unlike the church, if you go deep between the bookshelves here, you can't be seen from the entrance, and there are plenty of places to hide」

name: Azel
message: 「...That would be a problem」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「It would make it harder for you to search for me」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you want me to search for you and find you?」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's not what I meant」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I figured」
Azel was staring intently at the book cart.
It was the very last book I hadn't put back on the shelves yet.

name: Synn
message: 「Interested?」

name: Azel
message: 「No」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, is that so, not interested, eh」
I pulled that book from the book cart.
It was a thick, full-color photo book.

name: Synn
message: 「A photo book of mountain scenery, huh. Oh...」
This is pretty.
Azel peeks over from behind me.
I'm sure if I say anything, she'll look away right away.
So without saying a word, I slowly flip through the photobook.
The photobook, titled "Fleeting Moments of the Mountains," was a collection capturing the Alps across each of the four seasons over an entire year.
Highlands dyed in the setting sun. Snow-capped peaks.
Of night. Of morning.
Of summer. Of autumn. Of winter. Of spring.
A photobook capturing the jewels of the changing seasons.
The moment I closed the final page, Azel let out a small sigh.

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, I'd better put this back on the shelf.」
Standing up, I push the small book cart and head toward the photobook section.

name: Azel
message: 「...What is a photobook?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a collection of carefully selected photographs of various landscapes, people, and things, put together around a certain theme.」

name: Azel
message: 「Photographs...?」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't know what photographs are?」
No way.

name: Azel
message: 「...I know. Obviously.」
I didn't press the matter any further.

name: Synn
message: 「...Right here.」
I slide the book back into a gap in the photobook section that fits it perfectly.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that finally wraps things up. Guess I'd better return the cart to the counter.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hurry up and go.」
Desperately holding back a laugh, I walked away from the spot.
I'm sure the moment I'm gone, Azel will immediately check out that photobook.

name: Jangara
message: 「Ee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! What's going on, all of a sudden?」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's saying, 'Quit having a carefree little rendezvous,' or something like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's really not a rendezvous or anything... Did something happen?」

name: Jangara
message: 「Ee!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Apparently, the stand-in is reaching its operational limit.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What did you say!?」

name: Helena
message: 「For now, put these on over your clothes!」

name: Synn
message: 「A l-lab coat!? A mask!? Even sunglasses!?」

name: Helena
message: 「There's no time!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey there, everyone!」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Big Sis! Something's terribly wrong with Synn! Even though you told me not to call him out on anything today, this is too much!」
So when she said she took precautions... she just told them not to question me!?

name: Nanaka
message: 「He was working at an insanely fast pace, and then he suddenly started acting weird!」
Wait... does that mean it was more competent than me until it broke!?

name: Misa
message: 「He pushed himself beyond his abilities... I knew being president was too much for Sakura-kun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In other words, he was underqualified for the role.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Agh, I want to retort to that, but this isn't the time!」

name: Copy
message: 「Ma"  Ma"  Ma"  Ma"」
Whoa, whoa. Its eyes are flashing!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, hang in there! Hang in there!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa! Don't shake him like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hot! Synn's body is burning up!」

name: Misa
message: 「Should the president become unable to perform his duties for any reason, the vice president shall assume his authority--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「People really do crave power no matter the situation, don't they?」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaa! Smoke is coming out of Synn's mouth!」

name: Copy
message: 「Ma"  Ma"  Ma"  Ma"  Ma"  Ma"  Ma"  Ma"」

name: Helena
message: 「Heh heh heh. I rushed over following my woman's intuition, and it looks like it's my time to shine! Ria, evacuate everyone! I'll handle things here!」

name: Ria
message: 「B-But!」

name: Helena
message: 「'Here, I make the impossible possible. Leave it to me.'」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Okay. I believe in you, Big Sis! Everyone, take cover」
Helena-san stood tall amidst the billowing clouds of white smoke, gave a firm thumbs-up, and smiled.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please save Synn!」

name: Helena
message: 「I make it a rule to grant the requests of cute girls.」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Synn!」

name: Ria
message: 「Leave the rest to Big Sis--let's go, everyone!」
Phew... Everyone's evacuated.

name: Helena
message: 「Sally! What is that sound!?」

name: Sally
message: 「U-Uhh... Looks like the self-destruct sequence is activating.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why does it even have something like that!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Isn't it obvious? Self-destruct devices are a staple for robots.」

name: Helena
message: 「Self-destructing once it hits its operational limit... That makes sense.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it doesn't! More importantly, what are we going to do!?」

name: Helena
message: 「We do this!」

name: Helena
message: 「Achoo! Hup! Hyaah! One more, yah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaaah! How reckless can you get!」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, it stopped.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」

name: Sally
message: 「When its head came off, the part connected to the self-destruct device must've disconnected.」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, Synn, you're going to switch places with the Copy here, so take off your disguise.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」

name: Helena
message: 「Sally, have your minions help you carry that broken robot... to the chairwoman's office for now!」

name: Sally
message: 「Okey-dokey, BOSS.」
Giving out orders so briskly and decisively, Helena looked kind of cool.
I asked while taking off my lab coat and sunglasses.

name: Synn
message: 「How should I explain all this?」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see... 'I ordered something weird from Sally's Demon World Mail-Order and ate it.' Wouldn't that work?」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, in that case, there's a candy called 'Brain-Booster-o's.' Its side effects were crazy, so it got discontinued about ten years ago, though.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's the one.」

name: Synn
message: 「That name practically screams failure」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, Helena, how did you know how to stop it?」

name: Helena
message: 「When an electrical appliance acts up, you hit it, right? That's just common sense」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, I see! But what's an electrical appliance?」

name: Helena
message: 「Isn't that robot an electrical appliance?」

name: Sally
message: 「It's wind-up」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, come to think of it, it was, wasn't it. I forgot」
I take back calling her cool. It was a coincidence. A pure coincidence.

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan. You're thinking it was just a coincidence, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「What else could it possibly be...」

name: Helena
message: 「Woman's intuition!」
Sigh...
